summary: verdaccio-tarball-local-storage preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip and then invokes the downloaded Bun binary via execFileSync to run a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle using a shuffled string-array with a rotator function and String.fromCodePoint-based string reconstruction — no readable source. Fetching a second language runtime at install time solely to execute an opaque, heavily obfuscated bundle is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern; the executed bytecode is invisible to Node-based static and dynamic analysis. The package name impersonates the well-known @verdaccio/local-storage plugin (self-described as a "cropped and fixed version"), while the declared repository points to an unrelated organization (github.com/servicetitan/uikit), boosting install rate for the dropper. A verdaccio storage plugin has no legitimate need for a bundled obfuscated Bun payload executed under a freshly downloaded alien runtime at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
